C1816.title: Volkswagen Baunatal Plant Industrial Robot Fatality
C1816.summary: On June 29, 2015, a 22-year-old contractor technician was installing and commissioning a fixed industrial robot inside a safety guardrail at the Volkswagen Baunatal plant (near Kassel), with colleagues, on a new electric-motor production line. The robot started unexpectedly, grabbed his chest, and crushed him against a metal plate, causing severe chest trauma; he died in hospital. Volkswagen attributed the accident to human error, with no robot technical failure. This is one of the first widely reported robot-killing cases, driving ISO 10218 attention to commissioning-phase safety.
